prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: Production hero BACKGROUND asset for a website, newly generated from the approved visual reference.
Input image 1 is an appearance and geometry REFERENCE ONLY: a stacked theme comparison with typography. Use its sculpted smooth ribbon material and corner placement. Generate a SINGLE clean background, never the comparison board, never a screenshot, never retain or reproduce any UI.
Subject: exactly TWO distinct abstract ribbon sweeps with graceful large curves and softly shaded overlapping smooth sheet layers, one entering from lower-left, one entering from upper-right. Match the reference's intentional asymmetric relationship and layered material. The upper-right sweep flows off the top and right edges; lower-left sweep flows off the left and bottom edges. Both forms are partially cropped by canvas edges. There is no enclosing loop, circle, knot or complete freestanding object.
Material: smooth sculpted translucent-looking solid blue/cyan sheets, refined satin surface, soft depth and crisp restrained leading edges, no fabric, chrome, glass panels, grains or glitter.
Avoid: all text, letters, numbers, logos, icons, buttons, cards, UI, screenshots, navigation, extra sections, theme labels, borders, gutters, watermarks, neon, bloom, stars, particles, violet, magenta, busy decorations, generic waves across the entire canvas.
Composition/framing: a single ultra-wide landscape canvas, requested EXACTLY 2880x960 pixels, 3:1 aspect ratio. TWO ribbon sweeps at perimeter as in the reference. Lower-left footprint runs from left edge at about 25% canvas height down toward bottom edge around x=32%; upper-right enters top around x=69% and leaves right edge around y=65%. Keep the central reading area from x=24% to x=76% and y=12% to y=90% completely clear and flat, with ample negative space for two centered headline lines, description and side-by-side CTA that will be added in HTML. Do not put actual copy or buttons in this image. Ribbon accents remain peripheral and subordinate.
Color palette and backdrop: flat neutral charcoal #111111 ground, consistent #111111 across the central reading area and unoccupied edges. Smooth ribbon bodies use deep cobalt/royal blue with darker blue layered depth and slender cyan-lit leading edges. Match DARK bottom panel of reference. Low luminance inside ribbon forms with subtle depth. Cyan is a narrow clean highlight, never a glowing neon aura. No navy blue wash, grey texture or gradient across the center. Geometry and placements must match the light reference's shapes, recolored for dark mode.
